description: This file defines a specialized Vectorized class for the quantized type c10::quint8, including conversion, dequantization, quantization, and vector operations tailored for VSX (PowerPC Vector Scalar Extension) intrinsics.

classes.name: Vectorized<c10::quint8>
classes.description: A specialized vector class for c10::quint8 type, providing efficient SIMD operations, conversions, and dequantization/quantization methods using VSX intrinsics.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Converts quantized quint8 vector data to float vectors applying scale and zero point adjustments.

methods.name: quantize
methods.description: Quantizes float vectors into quint8 representation using scale, zero point, and inverse scale.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads unaligned vector data from memory into a Vectorized<c10::quint8> object.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores vector data from a Vectorized<c10::quint8> object into memory.

methods.name: widening_subtract
methods.description: Performs widening subtraction between two quint8 vectors, returning int32 vectors.

methods.name: relu
methods.description: Applies ReLU activation by max with zero point.

methods.name: relu6
methods.description: Applies ReLU6 activation, limiting values between zero point and q_six.
